timer.combinedPlaceholder: What are you working on? Type # for a task number

records.empty: No time entries yet. Start the timer to create your first one.
records.noteHint: Sent to ProofHub as the description; in a grouped push, entries with the same note are summed. Ctrl+Enter or clicking away saves, Esc cancels.
records.groupNotesDiffer: The entries in this group have different notes — click to set one for all
records.groupNoteReplaces: Replaces the notes of all {{count}} entries in this group (leave it untouched to keep them). Ctrl+Enter or clicking away saves, Esc cancels.
records.groupEditHint: Changes apply to all {{count}} entries in this group. Times stay per entry — expand the group to change them.
records.groupTagsHint: Tags only some entries have aren't shown; they're kept. What you add or remove here applies to all.
records.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete all {{count}} entries in this group?

editor.futureStart: Start can't be in the future
editor.invalidDateTime: Use yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or just HH:mm to keep the same date

projects.title: Projects
projects.aliasHint: Short code used to auto-fill this project when pasting "#task - CODE - description"
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project? Existing entries will keep it as an unassigned reference.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one to start tracking time against it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithSystemDescription: Launch Chronos automatically on login, minimized to the tray.
settings.globalShortcutDescription: Start/stop the timer from anywhere, even when Chronos isn't focused. Works alongside the tray icon's menu.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Couldn't register that shortcut — it may already be in use by another app.
settings.groupSimilarDescription: Combine entries with the same task and description on the same day into one row.
settings.updateReady: Update installed — restart to apply it.
settings.selfUpdateUnsupported: This install can't update itself (only the AppImage build can) — grab the new version from the releases page instead.
settings.autoBackupDescription: Periodically save a full JSON backup to a folder of your choice. Off by default.
settings.autoBackupRetentionDescription: How many backups to keep before deleting the oldest. Use 1 to always overwrite with just the latest.
settings.dataDescription: Chronos stores everything locally on this device. Nothing is sent over the network.
settings.importJsonWarning: Importing a backup replaces all current data.
settings.resetAllDescription: Permanently deletes every project and time entry on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all projects and time entries? This cannot be undone.

proofhub.title: ProofHub
proofhub.description: Send logged hours to ProofHub projects and tasks. Nothing related to this is downloaded or contacted until you install it.
proofhub.manageInTab: Installed — connect and manage project mappings in the ProofHub tab.
proofhub.groupPushesByDay: Group same-task entries when sending a day
proofhub.groupPushesByDayDescription: Entries with the same task, description and project on the same day are sent to ProofHub as a single summed entry instead of one per Chronos entry.
proofhub.debugLogHint: The exact request sent and response received for the last ProofHub call — useful when a push doesn't behave as expected. Overwritten each call; the API key is never included.
proofhub.debugLogEmpty: Nothing logged yet — make a ProofHub call, then reopen this.
proofhub.apiKeyHint: In ProofHub: profile icon (bottom-left) → API access.
proofhub.noProjects: No active projects to map yet.
proofhub.synced: Sent to ProofHub — click to send again
proofhub.outOfSync: Changed since it was sent — click to update it in ProofHub
proofhub.unitNote: sent together as one ProofHub entry: {{count}} entries, {{hours}}
proofhub.resendConfirm: This is already in ProofHub. Send it again? It's updated in place, or recreated if it was deleted there.
proofhub.resendDayConfirm: Everything on this day is already in ProofHub. Send all {{count}} entries ({{hours}}) again? Existing ones are updated in place, deleted ones recreated.
proofhub.linkTasks: Log time on the task by its #number
proofhub.linkTasksHint: Entries with a task number (e.g. #1234) are logged on that ProofHub task, in any of the project's task lists. Entries without one are logged on the project.
proofhub.errorUnderAMinute: Less than a minute — nothing to send.
proofhub.errorTaskNotFound: Task {{task}} wasn't found in this ProofHub project — check the number, or turn off task linking for this project.
proofhub.missing: Deleted in ProofHub — click to send it again
proofhub.changedRemotely: Changed in ProofHub (other hours or date) — click to overwrite it with Chronos's
proofhub.changedConfirm: This was changed in ProofHub (other hours or date). Overwrite it with what's in Chronos?
proofhub.forgetConfirm: Chronos will treat this as never sent. ProofHub isn't touched: if the entry still exists there, sending again creates a second one. Continue?
proofhub.checkDay: Check ProofHub for entries deleted or changed there
proofhub.sendDayChangedConfirm: Send {{count}} ProofHub entries ({{hours}} in total)? {{changed}} of them were changed in ProofHub and will be overwritten.
proofhub.checkSentDescription: Compares the last {{days}} days both ways: marks what you sent that was deleted or changed in ProofHub, and lists your ProofHub entries that Chronos didn't send.
proofhub.checkSentFound: Found in ProofHub: {{missing}} deleted, {{changed}} changed. They're marked in the timer tab.
proofhub.checkSentNothing: All {{count}} sent entries are still in ProofHub as sent.
proofhub.remoteOnlyHint: Your entries in the mapped timesheets that no Chronos entry was sent as — logged by hand there, or left over from an old send. Teammates' entries are ignored.
proofhub.remoteOnlyNone: Nothing in ProofHub that isn't in Chronos.
proofhub.remoteOnlyDeleteConfirm: Delete the ProofHub entry of {{date}} ({{hours}})? This can't be undone in Chronos.
proofhub.projectMappingsDescription: Which ProofHub project and timesheet each Chronos project's hours go to. Unmapped projects are never sent.
proofhub.nothingPending: Everything from the last 30 days is in ProofHub.
proofhub.sendAllConfirm: Send {{count}} ProofHub entries from {{days}} days ({{hours}} in total)?
proofhub.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect from ProofHub? The API key is removed from this computer; project mappings and what was already sent are kept.
